Represents shares sold pursuant to "sell-to-cover" transactions to satisfy tax withholding obligations arising upon settlement of 2,100,000 of Mr. Ortiz's restricted stock units ("RSUs") that vested on September 30, 2026 and settled in shares on November 18, 2026.
